items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: and Joe Glaser called me to come in. So I came into New York and I talked to Joe and Joe said go to Karnak and fit yourself.

ctx.x: At this point when they asked me to come to join Louis, many times I've thought about the times in front of the Sunset, when I was 17 years old, and Louis was 29. I never dreamed I would be with Louis Armstrong. It was a privileged opportunity. It was great to be asked to join the band. When they-----left St. Louis, I was in St. Louis for a week, and Joe Glaser called me to come in. So I came into New York and I talked to Joe and Joe said go to Karnak and fit yourself. Karnak will build you some uniforms.

I called Glaser and Joe Glaser said to Go to Karnak, tailor shop at 48th and 7th Avenue so I was fitted with three uniforms, one was dark blue with white buttons and another one was light blue, sky-blue and the third one was gray, gray pants and gray sport coat. That morning I reported for my measurements and late afternoon those uniforms were ready to be worn. That night I opened with Louie at the Zanzibar on 49th and Broadway.
